messages.author: e13072fd07a5d80a
messages.subject: Automation
parts:
I'm trying automate the process of adding users and re-deploying my app through Automator on my mac.  I keep getting an error in the automator without any message.  The R script that searches for new users and re-deploys works when I run it manually, and the automator script works when I comment out the 'shinyapps' commands (addAuthorizedUser, authorizedUsers).  So, it looks like the automator is tripping up on the shinyapps commands.  Do you have any ideas of why this might be, or any possible solutions?  Thanks!

Josh

messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: Re: Automation
parts:
Josh,

It's hard to say why this is not working without any error message. Does your automator script have permission to read and write to your application directory?

-Andy

parts: That helped.  It now will run through process successfully, but it's like automator creates it's own R session.
